papers.title_en: Vision Token Pruning via Query-Vision Interaction Decomposition
papers.authors: Harshithanjani Athi, Sravan Kumar Ankireddy, Jianzhong Charlie Zhang, Hyeji Kim
papers.evidence: 基于查询-视觉交互低秩分解的视觉令牌剪枝
papers.tldr: 大型视觉语言模型因视觉 token 数量多而推理成本高，视觉 token 剪枝是提升效率的自然途径。现有方法多用注意力模式或 token 动态等启发式引入查询信息，却未显式利用查询-视觉交互结构。本文提出免训练的 QViD，利用注意力中查询-键投影诱导的低秩交互矩阵分解，实现查询感知的视觉 token 剪枝。在图像与视频理解基准上，同等 token 预算下性能稳定提升，激进压缩时增益最大。
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models (VLMs), which process both visual inputs and text queries, incur high inference costs due to the large number of visual tokens, making visual token pruning a natural approach for improving efficiency. Recent work has leveraged query information to guide token selection, often through heuristics derived from attention patterns or token dynamics. However, these approaches do not explicitly exploit the underlying structure of query-vision interactions. We address this gap by observing that the query-vision interaction matrix, naturally induced by the query and key projections already present in transformer attention, is effectively low-rank, with a small number of dominant latent interaction modes capturing query-relevant semantics. Motivated by this observation, we propose Query-Vision Decomposition (QViD), a novel training-free query-aware visual token pruning method that exploits this structure. Extensive experiments on both image and video understanding benchmarks show that QViD consistently improves performance under matched token budgets, with the largest gains appearing under aggressive compression regimes.

papers.title_en: Rescuing Your Pruning: Rethinking Visual Token Pruning and Post-Training Recovery in MLLMs
papers.authors: Peiran Yin, Hao Wu, Zihao Yang, Haozhe Hu, Xudong Wang, Xiaoyu Shen
papers.evidence: 多模态大模型中的视觉token剪枝合并与训练后恢复
papers.tldr: 视觉token剪枝能降低MLLM推理成本，但现有免训练方法多把性能损失视为必然代价。作者构建282K混合后训练数据，在统一协议下训练36种token丢弃/合并配置，检验后训练恢复与联合压缩。结果显示后训练可挽回大部分损失（含OCR与定位），且预算越紧收益越大；编码器而非LLM主导原生分辨率预填充，剪枝位置比数量更关键。最佳配置轻剪编码器、重剪投影器、保持LLM完整，LLM阶段加速3.49倍但端到端首token仅加速1.54倍。
papers.abstract_en: Visual token pruning substantially reduces the inference cost of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), yet existing methods are mostly training-free and plug-and-play. They treat the resulting performance drop as an inevitable cost of compression and pursue increasingly complex pruning rules. We rethink this view through two questions: how much of the loss can post-training rescue, and, building on this recovery, how can joint compression push pruning to its limit? We curate a 282K-sample post-training mixture covering general VQA, reasoning, OCR, and grounding, and post-train 36 configurations that drop or merge tokens under a unified protocol. Post-training rescues most of the loss, even for OCR and grounding, and its adaptation gain in closing the gap between the pruned and the dense model grows as the budget tightens. For joint compression, we find that the vision encoder, not the LLM, dominates prefill time in native-resolution MLLMs, so where tokens are removed matters more than how many: keeping 40% of tokens at the encoder runs faster than keeping 10% at the projector. Our best configuration prunes the encoder lightly and the projector aggressively, leaves the LLM intact, and keeps general understanding and reasoning at the dense level. It accelerates the LLM stage by 3.49x but the end-to-end time-to-first-token by only 1.54x, showing that LLM-stage speedups overstate end-to-end gains. We hope these findings offer insights for future research on joint visual token compression. Our data, protocol, and code will be released.

papers.title_en: RAQ-MLA: Role-Aware Quantization for Multi-Head Latent Attention Caches
papers.authors: Tianqi Chen, Xunchao Li, Linchuan Xie, Guanghua Yu, Jianchen Zhu, Peisong Wang, Jian Cheng
papers.evidence: 面向大模型多头潜在注意力的角色感知KV缓存量化
papers.tldr: MLA 已被前沿大模型采用，但现有 KV-cache 量化方法面向标准注意力的键值设计，未考虑 MLA 实际缓存的内容，因此低比特下精度损失明显。作者从激活分布和量化误差如何传播到注意力输出入手，发现压缩 latent 主要提供 value，位置键主导注意力分数。据此提出 RAQ-MLA，为每个缓存张量拟合可逆变换，分别以注意力加权 value 误差和分数扰动为目标。无需训练即可把完整 MLA 缓存量化至约 2.5 bit/元素，理论缓存容量提升 6.5 倍，四个 MLA 模型上的推理与编码任务几乎无损。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) has been adopted by recent frontier large language models. Instead of per-head keys and values, MLA caches a compressed KV latent that is up-projected into keys and values at decode time, together with a narrow positional key that carries position information into the attention score. Existing KV-cache quantization methods are designed around the keys and values of standard attention and do not account for what MLA actually caches, which costs accuracy at low bit widths. We analyze the MLA cache both in activation distribution and in how quantization error propagates to the attention output, and show that the two cached tensors play different roles: the latent mainly supplies the values, whereas the positional key dominates the attention score. We therefore propose RAQ-MLA (Role-Aware Quantization for Multi-Head Latent Attention Caches), which fits an invertible transform to each cached tensor against the error that tensor delivers to the attention output: attention-weighted value error for the latent and score perturbation for the positional key. Without training, RAQ-MLA quantizes the full MLA cache to about 2.5 bits per element, a 6.5x increase in theoretical KV-cache capacity, while remaining nearly lossless on reasoning and coding tasks across four MLA models.

papers.title_en: TrackTok: Object-Centric Video Tokenization with Semantically Persistent Tokens
papers.authors: Nhi Pham, Christopher Wewer, Bernt Schiele, Jonas Fischer, Jan Eric Lenssen
papers.evidence: 保留时序语义持续性的紧凑对象中心视频token
papers.tldr: 传统视频分词器的 token 多绑定固定图像位置，难以在物体移动、形变或遮挡时保持语义一致。TrackTok 学习以物体为中心、跨帧持续的对象级 token，将视觉特征绑定为稳定语义单元，形成更紧凑的连续视频潜表示。在 UCF-101 上以约 8 倍更少潜 token 取得可比 FVD 和更优时延，并在 Kinetics-600 低 token 预算帧预测中优于 1D 分词基线。该工作表明对象对齐且时间持续的分词可提升视频生成建模效率。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce TrackTok, an efficient video tokenization framework that produces object-centric tokens, i.e., tokens that consistently encode the same semantic objects across time, even as it moves, deforms, or undergoes partial occlusion. Conventional patch-based or existing holistic tokenizers produce token identities often tied to fixed image locations. In contrast, our approach learns temporally persistent object-centric representations that bind visual features across frames into stable semantic units. This enables substantially more compact, continuous latent video representations, reducing the number of tokens required for downstream generative modeling with state-of-the-art flow models, while preserving the semantic structure needed for high-quality synthesis. Our tokenizer offers a favorable quality-efficiency trade-off. TrackTok achieves comparable class-conditional generative FVD on UCF-101 dataset at 8 times fewer latent tokens and better latency, and outperforms existing 1D tokenization baselines on frame prediction task on Kinetics-600 across low token budgets. These results suggest that object-aligned and temporally persistent tokenization is a promising direction for scalable video generation, where reducing latent token counts is critical for efficient modeling. Our code for this work is available at https://github.com/phamleyennhi/tracktok.

papers.title_en: TP-JSCC: Efficient Token Pruning and Joint Source-Channel Coding for LVLMs-based 3D-VQA in Cloud-Edge Collaboration
papers.authors: Zhengxin Li, Chongzhen Tian, Hui Yuan, Hao Liu, Sam Kwong
papers.evidence: 混合视觉Token剪枝显著降低LVLM的视觉Token数量
papers.tldr: 面向资源受限具身智能体在带宽受限、噪声信道下执行3D视觉问答时，海量视觉数据上传会带来严重时延与传输失真，论文提出云边协同的TP-JSCC方法。其先利用局部与全局语义混合令牌剪枝LGS-HTP解耦前景背景并保留推理关键令牌，大幅降低视觉令牌冗余；随后用轻量级令牌联合信源信道编码T-JSCC及信噪比自适应机制进一步压缩并稳健传输。ScanQA验证集上90%剪枝仅损失不足1% CIDEr，T-JSCC再压缩18倍，总体数据量降低180倍并节省90%计算复杂度，为云边3D-VQA提供高效鲁棒方案。
papers.abstract_en: Deploying large vision-language models (LVLMs) on resource-constrained embodied agents for 3D visual question answering necessitates cloud-edge collaboration. However, offloading massive visual data to the cloud over bandwidth-limited and noisy channels introduces severe latency and transmission distortion. To address this, we propose TP-JSCC, an efficient token pruning and joint source-channel coding method for LVLMs-based 3D-VQA in Cloud-Edge Collaboration. First, we develop a Local and Global Semantics-based Hybrid Token Pruning (LGS-HTP) module to significantly reduce the visual token count. By decoupling foreground-background tokens and jointly selecting local and global semantics, LGS-HTP effectively reduces redundancy while preserving reasoning-critical tokens. Second, we introduce a lightweight Token Joint Source-Channel Coding (T-JSCC) module to further compress the pruned tokens and ensure their robust transmission over error-prone channels. By employing lightweight cascaded linear layers and Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR)-adaptive mechanism, this module adapts to fluctuating channel conditions while maintaining minimal computational overhead. Extensive experiments on ScanQA and SQA3D datasets indicate the exceptional efficiency and robustness of our approach. Specifically, on ScanQA validation set, the LGS-HTP module could achieve 90% pruning ratio while incurring less than a 1% CIDEr loss. Building on this, the T-JSCC further compresses the tokens by 18 times, resulting in an overall 180 times data volume reduction for robust transmission, while saving 90% in computational complexity for LVLM deployment. Our code is available at https://github.com/yuanhui0325/TP-JSCC.

papers.title_en: Recast the Past: Stable Long Video Generation with Full Context Memory
papers.authors: Yukuo Ma, Cong Liu, Junke Wang, Junqi Liu, Haibin Huang, Zuxuan Wu, Xuelong Li
papers.evidence: 将长视频历史压缩为记忆 token 并缓解时序漂移
papers.tldr: 长视频生成需保留不断扩张的历史，但直接以增长 token 序列为条件代价高且易丢失信息。ReCam 将历史潜变量的局部时空块聚合成向量，投影到 Diffusion Transformer 高维隐空间，以记忆 token 经自注意力访问全历史。它还提出双指针去噪，为近期上下文和目标帧设置独立噪声调度以缓解时间漂移。在 VBench-Long 上取得 80.1 的最高总分，并在离屏主体重现的服装一致性上达 4.09。
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon video generation requires retaining an ever-expanding history, but conditioning on its growing token sequence is costly. Existing methods restrict or compress historical context, potentially losing information needed for future generation. This work proposes ReCam, which groups local spatiotemporal blocks of historical latents into vectors and projects them directly into the high-dimensional hidden space of a Diffusion Transformer. The model learns to use the resulting memory tokens through native self-attention, reducing token count while retaining block-level access to the full history. To mitigate temporal drift during autoregressive rollout, we further introduce dual-pointer denoising with separate noise schedules for recent context and target frames. Among the evaluated methods, ReCam achieves the highest VBench-Long overall score of 80.1 and competitive static-scene revisitation performance on R2M-Bench. It also leads on all four consistency metrics for off-screen subject reappearance, including clothing consistency of 4.09 versus 3.03 for the best baseline.

papers.title_en: AGQ: Action-Guided Ultra-Low-Bit Quantization for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.authors: Xuhong Qiu, Zhuoyu Wu, Qiawei Zheng, Wenhui Ou, Wenqi Fang, Raphaël C. -W. Phan
papers.evidence: 对大权重矩阵做超低比特量化并用逐通道校准补偿误差
papers.tldr: VLA模型权重庞大，难以部署在内存受限的机器人平台；超低比特量化虽能压缩模型，却易损任务性能且权重恢复开销难控。AGQ以动作敏感度和权重恢复代价代理为依据，在存储预算下分配矩阵位宽，并结合逐通道校准、矩阵内均匀位宽与按位分组无损编码。在LIBERO上，W3任务成功率达92.7%，优于AWQ和GPTQ；W2.5仍保留70.5%。其非对称W1.5*配置配合无损编码实现6.10倍整模型压缩，为VLA低比特部署提供可行路径。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable robots to perform tasks specified through natural-language instructions, but their large weight footprint challenges deployment on memory-constrained onboard platforms. Ultra-low-bit quantization reduces this footprint, yet preserving task performance and controlling weight recovery costs remain challenging. We propose Action-Guided Quantization, which combines action sensitivity with a measured proxy for weight recovery cost to allocate matrix bitwidths under storage budgets. Per-channel calibration compensates for quantization error, while a uniform bitwidth within each matrix preserves regular layouts. Bit-dependent grouped lossless coding reduces resident weight storage, and block-wise recovery limits temporary buffers. On LIBERO, AGQ achieves 92.7% task success at W3, exceeding AWQ and GPTQ by 1.2 and 3.7 percentage points, respectively, and retains 70.5% success at W2.5. An asymmetric configuration, denoted W1.5$^{*}$, uses W4 vision weights and a parameter-weighted average of 1.5 bits for language weights. With lossless coding, it achieves $6.10\times$ complete-model compression relative to BF16 while retaining 25.5% task success. Code and experimental results are available at https://github.com/Qiuxu00/AGQ
